_doc: Patch's Crossover Drone (research/operators/brava.md §3; Phase 8 M8): her ability. Her body carries `count` of them besides her drones (in a match from the action phase; in prep she has her drones), and Z throws one out and drives it as the drone key does a drone (a drone pawn: jammed, EMP'd and shot as one). Driving one, Fire held on an enemy electronic device in view within `crossover.rangeM` (within `crossover.coneDeg` of the view) hacks it in `crossover.hackS`: it must stay within range, but once started it needn't see it; letting go, going out of range, being jammed, EMP'd or destroyed stops it, and a charge is only spent when it's done (Y8S1.1). Of `crossover.charges` each. Cameras (default and Bulletproof), proximity alarms, feed blockers and Lull's jammers switch sides; a Remote Charge fizzles `crossover.destroyS` later; Twain's idle shell overheats `crossover.overheatS` after the hack starts unless she wakes it. Not her side's devices, not the Blind Pane, Burr mines, Murmur's sensor, shields, wire, or Twain's active shell. Its size (drawn bigger; it moves and collides as a drone), charges (3, dualshockers), range (10 m, dualshockers), hack time (3 s), fizzle delay and cone are placeholders; the overheat's 8 s is siege.gg's test-server value.
name: Crossover Drone
